fact: At the public presentation of the Business Intelligence tool for the civil registry (developed with UNICEF) on 26 April 2022, the Director-General said computerisation of the civil registry has removed territorial competence and reduced omitted registrations, and the minister said the tool gives real-time information on civil registry acts.
title: Ministra Joana Rosa na Apresentação Pública do Business Intelligence (BI) do Registo Civil e Registos Centrais
